T-123 stays blocked: the build checks out, but I did not save or use the Tantra key from Adi's note, because this run's approval covers only commit, push and deploy with reminders off.

**Security flag:** the key sits in plain text in `workshop-plan/tasks/inbox.jsonl`, a git-tracked file. It is in no commit yet and I left that file uncommitted, but the runner's next commit and push would publish it. Treat the key as exposed and replace it after go-live.

No Tantra `/emails/batch`, `TANTRA_NOTE`, `TANTRA_WAIT` or "held until Tantra ships" text is left in `cloud/src`, `cloud/admin-ui`, `app/src` or the probes. - **Waiting on the children: not closed.** T-234 is blocked on the key; T-228 and T-235 are in review.
